title: Resolution urging Albany to formally apologize for slavery
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.1660/A.10463. That bill would have New York State acknowledge the history of slavery within its borders and issue a formal apology for its role in perpetuating it. The resolution cites New York's history of slavery from 1626 through abolition in 1827 and its lasting effects.
